This document outlines the 
equipment maintenance inspection on the 6 kv CB and 380v CB which must be performed every 1500 hours of 
operation. This procedure was applied in Abu Qir power plant since 1985 and the 
finial draft is issued in august 2004

the first draft is initiated in 
August 2004 
by eng. Mohamed Hassan Toto, 
approved by eng. Khalil Aly Khalil General Director of Abu Kir PS, accepted by 
eng. Ahmed Taha Hashim Head Sector of Abu Kir PS.

Reviewed by eng. Ahmad El Sharkawy Inspection and Quality Control general 
Director of WDEPC.

A work permit must be issued and qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Insure that the circuit breaker is switched off in coordinate with the 
 shift engineer

items:
Clean all the outer parts of the CB specially the 6 
kv insulators

Visual inspection of the C.O. oil level (not less than half of 
 the glass-fill in if required

Measure the insulation resistance of the oil 30 kv if not O.K change the 
 oil

Connect and disconnect 
 the spring manually, using the electric circuit , using the plug and the 
 electric circuit

Maintain the shocks absorption cylinder by increasing 
 the oil level till the middle and change cell 34 and its gasket

Grease the following parts: 
 Figure (2)
 * Internal gears parts 152
 * Parts 141 with grease type SKF 63
 * Main spring parts 161 by hand to be sure all parts are 
 greased
 * Chains group part 155
 * Parts 156

Lubricate the following parts:
 * Chain connecting mobile part of motor
 * Reverse movement of the CB
 * Internal holes

Lubricate the 6 kv feeding sockets of the CB with puste melydal 
 ELS.
Check mechanical interlock.
Withdraw the contactor and check its state.
Clean the internal parts from dust.

Tighten the bolts and check the mechanical and electrical 
 connection parts if they are in a good condition.
Check the diodes in its direction.

Check the operation of thermal and mechanical for each one and 
 check the on and off switch.
Check and measure the fuses in good state.
Clean the contacts and change if needed.

Check and adjust the limit switch for the contactor of the 
 following types:
 RD 80, 
 RD 125, 
 RD 250
Check the relay fixation.
Check the faulty lamps.
Test the internal parts by using the avometer
Grease the mettle parts spatially the connected parts

Test the time of connection and disconnection of the thermal 
 of each contactor according to the curve figure (1)
